config_bundle.Description: Path to the config zip bundle

detect_md5hash.Description: A hash of local config bundle in string, user needs to use a Terraform Hash function of their choice. A change in hash will trigger an update.

latest_revision_id.Description: The id of the most recently created revision for this shared flow.

md5hash.Description: Base 64 MD5 hash of the uploaded config bundle.

created_at.Description: Time at which the API proxy was created, in milliseconds since epoch.

last_modified_at.Description: Time at which the API proxy was most recently modified, in milliseconds since epoch.

name.Description: The ID of the shared flow.

org_id.Description: The Apigee Organization name associated with the Apigee instance.

revision.Description: A list of revisions of this shared flow.
